subject: a Persian scholar and physician of the early 11th century with a neatly trimmed dark beard, a white turban and long layered robes of Central Asian style, thoughtful calm eyes

panels.01-bukhara: the city of Bukhara in Central Asia around 980 AD at golden hour, mud-brick walls, domes and a citadel, a caravan of camels arriving, orchards and a river, wide establishing shot, medieval Samanid era
panels.02-lessons: a ten-year-old Persian boy in a simple robe and small cap sitting cross-legged at a low wooden reading stand with an open handwritten manuscript, an elderly bearded teacher in a turban beside him, a quiet sunlit study room in Bukhara, around 990 AD, respectful and studious
panels.03-young-doctor: a sixteen-year-old Persian youth in a turban and robe kneeling beside a resting patient on a floor cushion, gently feeling the patient's pulse at the wrist, older physicians in turbans watching and taking notes, oil lamp, Bukhara around 996 AD, calm and dignified, not graphic
panels.04-library: {S} as a young man of seventeen walking in wonder through a royal library of several rooms filled with stacked wooden chests overflowing with manuscripts and scrolls, light from high windows, Samanid palace in Bukhara around 997 AD
panels.05-bookseller: {S} as a young man at a busy medieval Bukhara book market stall, a bookseller holding out a small cheap handwritten book to him, piles of manuscripts, morning light, around 998 AD, a moment of discovery
panels.06-vizier: {S} at night in a lamplit room in Hamadan around 1015 AD, dictating from notes to a circle of seated students who write on paper with reed pens, stacks of manuscripts, warm lamp glow, scholarly atmosphere
panels.07-canon: {S} writing a large handwritten medical book at a low desk by oil lamp light, open manuscripts with drawings of medicinal plants around him, a student copying pages nearby, Persian room with carved wooden window, around 1025 AD, quiet focus
panels.08-legacy: a Renaissance European university lecture hall in the late 1400s, a professor in a dark gown reading from a large printed Latin medical book at a wooden lectern, rows of students in period dress listening and taking notes, tall arched windows, golden light
